paper_evidence: The paper states that lattice transmission towers are composed of steel angle sections and labels them tower-lattice.
license: Apache-2.0 repository license; mirror instructs users to consult original dataset terms before redistribution or commercial use
scope_warning: tower_lattice is an assembly-level structural-region target for transmission towers. It is not an individual steel member, corrosion mask, or distribution-pole crossarm material label.

selection.source_group: filename prefix before the first underscore
selection.positive: At least one mirror tower_lattice polygon
selection.hard_negative: No tower_lattice polygon and at least one tower_wooden or tower_tucohy polygon

model.checkpoint_selection: final epoch; no test or UK selection

budget: One gputest job, at most 15 minutes, one supervised run plus one frozen open-vocabulary baseline. No automatic extension.
